description: This file contains unit tests for the IPC Controller component in the Rialto server manager, using Google Test framework. It defines a test fixture class 'IpcTests' with methods to simulate IPC events, configure responses, and trigger actions on the Controller object.

classes.name: IpcTests
classes.description: A test fixture class for testing the IPC Controller component, providing methods to simulate IPC events, configure responses, and trigger actions.
